description: Vertical 1080x1920, 30fps. Near-black background. Frame 0 is bold and immediate: thick horizontal white beam (fg=white with glow) spans full width at mid-frame 45-55% height, already sweeping left-to-right with motion blur, plus huge bold kinetic text SUNLIGHT (fg=white) centered at ~30% height. No important elements in top 10% or bottom 25%. Second shot after hard cut: full-bleed bright blue sky dome gradient (accent=cyan to light blue) filling 10-75% height, white sun glow disc at 22% center, soft white horizon glow. Text stays centered in safe middle band.

beats.action: Thick white beam sweeps left-to-right across dark background at mid-frame, huge SUNLIGHT text pops in center above beam
Beam brightens to pure white glow and thickens, small label white = all colors fades in below beam in muted=grey
Beam freezes, large kinetic text why is sky BLUE? slams in center, WHY scales up, BLUE in accent=cyan
Hard cut to bright blue dome sky filling frame with sun glow, white BLUE? text centered, pattern interrupt to new shot

description: Vertical 1080x1920. Continuous remotion 2D motion graphics. Shot A: dark background, horizontal white light bar (fg=white) at 40% height left side firing rightward. It fans into 6-color spectrum ribbons (red-orange-accent3=yellow-green-accent=cyan-blue) spreading to right edge at 40-55% height with labels. Shot B pullback: small Earth circle (blue oceans, green land, fg=white cloud hints) centered at 50% height, thin glowing atmosphere shell (accent=cyan glow) around it, sun rays from left. Blue scattered arrows spray outward around atmosphere, single straight red arrow pierces through. Background tints from black to deep blue.

beats.action: White horizontal bar enters from left at mid-frame firing right, label WHITE SUNLIGHT above it
White bar fans into 6 separate color ribbons forming rainbow spectrum, each ribbon labeled, spreading rightward
Camera pulls back, Earth circle with thin glowing cyan atmosphere ring appears center-right, spectrum aims at it
Spectrum hits atmosphere layer, splits: blue ribbon breaks into scattered short arrows, red stays straight
Blue scattered arrows spray everywhere around atmosphere in all directions, background starts tinting accent=cyan blue
Single long red arrow glides straight through atmosphere past Earth without scattering, labeled RED STRAIGHT

description: Vertical 1080x1920. Macro close-up 2D field: dark blue-black void that gradually tints blue. Diagonal sunbeam from top-left to center (45% height) containing two overlaid waves: short choppy blue zigzag (accent=cyan) and long smooth red sine (red). Five glowing air molecule dots (fg=white with accent=cyan glow) scattered center 40-60% height, one hero molecule circled center. Size-comparison brackets show dot << wavelength. Eye icon (fg=white) at 65% center representing viewer. Scattered blue arrows emanate omnidirectionally, red line continues straight to right edge. Final wide: many sky patches with blue arrows converging into eye.

beats.action: Diagonal sunbeam enters top-left to center, five glowing molecule dots fade in mid-frame, hero molecule highlighted
Camera pushes into hero molecule, label TINY AIR MOLECULE callout appears, dots pulse
Size brackets appear: tiny dot vs long wave, text WAY SMALLER THAN WAVE pops below molecule
Blue choppy zigzag isolates and enlarges in beam, red dims, label SHORT CHOPPY BLUE WAVE
Blue zigzag slams into hero molecule, impact flash, molecule glows bright cyan
Blue impact bursts into 8 blue arrows Up down sideways from molecule, labels UP DOWN SIDEWAYS pop sequentially
Red long smooth sine isolates and enlarges, blue dims, label LONG SMOOTH RED WAVE
Red sine glides straight past molecules without deflecting, straight motion line extends to right edge
Zoom out to many sky patches, blue scattered arrows from every patch converge into eye icon center-bottom
Whole background washes bright blue, arrows from all directions pour into eye, text ALL DIRECTIONS AT ONCE centers

description: Vertical 1080x1920. Shot A horizon view: bright blue sky dome (accent=cyan) 10-60% height with sun high, eye icon at 65% center. Sun drops to horizon at 55% height, sky shifts to orange-magenta gradient (orange to accent2=magenta), long low red rays (red) travel horizontally to eye. Blue side-scatter arrows peel away upward and fade. Shot B loop rhyme: cuts back to near-black background with same thick horizontal white beam (fg=white) at 45-55% spanning width as hook frame 0, small BLUE SKY text in accent=cyan centered, visually rhyming hook for clean loop.

beats.action: Blue sky darkens, sun drops to horizon line at mid-frame, sky gradient shifts toward orange
Blue arrows veer sideways and fade away above horizon, label BLUE SCATTERED AWAY peels off
Single thick straight red ray survives low across horizon into eye icon, eye glows red, label ONLY RED SURVIVES
Hard reset: cut to dark background, original thick white beam sweeps back across mid-frame matching hook frame 0
White beam holds center on black with small blue SKY BLUE text below, exact rhyme of opening beam for loop replay
